label.en: Starts the "A Rift in Space" situation

label.zh: 我们当前的情况还不允许花费如此宝贵的资源。在远处观测这一现象即可。
label.en: We are not in a position to spend such valuable resources. Let us observe this phenomenon from afar.

label.zh: 可以让我们的科学家们分配大量的研究资源以揭开这一时空裂隙的秘密。
label.en: We can dedicate a significant amount of research from our scientists towards unlocking the secrets of this rift in space and time.

label.zh: 这一应对方案将会极大地加速我们的研究。
label.en: This Approach will greatly accelerate our research.

label.zh: 往裂隙中发送的每一个探测器都能加深我们对如何穿透其边界的理解。我们可以分配合金总产出的一部分用于此项目。
label.en: Each probe we send into the rift furthers our understanding of how to penetrate its borders. We are able to dedicate a certain amount of our total Alloy production for this purpose.

label.zh: 这一应对方案将会极大地加速我们的研究。
label.en: This Approach will greatly accelerate our research.
